أنفرث (form VII)
# أَنْفَرِثُ (ʔanfariṯu) /ʔan.fa.ri.θu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# أَنْفَرِثَ (ʔanfariṯa) /ʔan.fa.ri.θa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# أَنْفَرِثْ (ʔanfariṯ) /ʔan.fa.riθ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
